summary: Wide gravel verge off Bowhill Road beside paddocks, with tyre marks and no close homes.
reasons: Wide gravel pull-in clear of the lane
Paddocks behind; houses over 40 m south
Tyre tracks show vehicles stop here

best_section.where: Gravel verge on the north side, just west of the powerline track mouth

drivers.seclusion: Paddocks to the north; nearest homes across the road, about 40-60 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel verge meets the road edge; room for a van fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Rural through road with moving traffic; the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Tyre tracks on the verge; no vans or tents seen.

flags: Powerline track gate just east; keep clear of its mouth
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, Blunder Creek 59 m away
sun_shade: Open to the north and east; trees along the west edge shade the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Firmness of the verge after rain
